practiceReport.beatComment: Still wasn't on the Chargers' practice report until Friday, when he was a limited participant due to an ankle injury. Still's next chance to play will be in Week 12 against New England on Sunday, Nov. 29.

practiceReport.name: Justin Herbert
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 98% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Remains in early stages of NFL 5-Step Concussion Protocol
practiceReport.beatComment: Herbert completed 15 of 21 passes for 131 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions in Week 11, but he also endured six sacks, fumbled once and added 32 yards and one TD on his eight carries. It's unclear exactly when he picked up the head injury, but he'll be subject to the concussion protocol for further game action. The Chargers take the field next Sunday against the Patriots.

practiceReport.name: Trey Pipkins III
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (OT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 3); logged Full Participation in prior week's ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Pipkins had been on IR since late September before being activated Saturday. The veteran offensive lineman is now set to give the Chargers' offensive line a boost. Pipkins may work in a rotational role, as Logan Taylor is "locked in" at left guard, per Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com.

practiceReport.name: Keaton Mitchell
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (76%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Mitchell temporarily exited the contest in the first half due to a back issue. However, he's since returned to the game as part of the kickoff-return unit. Mitchell is thus set to resume his usual role as both a backup RB and special-teams ace.

practiceReport.name: Akheem Mesidor
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (81%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Mesidor suffered an ankle injury during the first half, and his status for the rest of the game is now uncertain. In the rookie's absence, Caleb Murphy and Bud Dupree are both candidates to see an increase in opportunities at outside linebacker behind starters Tuli Tuipulotu and Khalil Mack.

practiceReport.name: Charlie Kolar
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Kolar showed up on the Chargers' first Week 11 injury report Wednesday as a non-participant due to a concussion, and thereafter he managed just one limited session Friday before the team tagged him as questionable for Sunday. Despite his inability to practice fully this week and the prospect of gaining clearance from an independent neurologist shaped up as a difficult combination to overcome, he's available to the offense. Kolar will join Oronde Gadsden and David Njoku as L.A.'s active tight ends this weekend.

practiceReport.name: David Njoku
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Njoku briefly exited in the first quarter after hurting his shoulder on a 13-yard catch. He was initially deemed questionable to return but has since re-entered the contest. The veteran tight end is playing just his second game after returning from a stint on IR due to a fibula injury.

practiceReport.name: Justin Eboigbe
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Eboigbe was unable to play against the Ravens this past Monday due to an ankle injury. He ended Week 11 prep with a full practice Friday, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag ahead of Sunday's contest. His return means there will be less rotational snaps at defensive end for rookie fifth-rounder Nick Barrett.

practiceReport.name: Isas Waxter
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Waxter was cleared to return from a one-game absence due to an ankle injury. His availability gives the Chargers another contributor on special teams and depth in the secondary.
